show.summary: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.

episodes.summary:
WWE's 2015 Slammy Awards will be held during Monday Night Raw, Monday, December 21, live at 8pm ET/PT as part of WWE Week on USANetwork. WWE's version of the Oscars, the annual fan-voted awards honor the best of the year with their own golden statue in 18 categories. For the first time in Slammy Award history, voting will take place exclusively through Facebook, Twitter and Instagram beginning tonight during Monday Night Raw for 10 of the categories including:

· WWE Superstar of the Year, every WWE Superstar on the roster is an eligible nominee for the first time

· WWE Tag Team of the Year

· Hashtag of the Year

· Celebrity Moment of the Year

· "Tell Me You Didn't Just Say That" Moment of the Year

· Best John Cena United States Championship Open Challenge Match of the Year

· Rivalry of the Year

· Double Cross of the Year

· Surprise Return of the Year

· Best Original WWE Network Show

On Monday, December 21, fans can vote for the remaining eight categories exclusively through the WWE App during The Slammy Awards, live during Monday Night Raw on USA Network, where nine awards will be handed out, including the coveted WWE Superstar of the Year honor. Additional awards to be handed out that evening include:

· Match of the Year

· WWE Diva of the Year

· Breakout Star of the Year

· LOL Moment of the Year

· Extreme Moment of the Year

· "This is Awesome" Moment of the Year

· The OMG Shocking Moment of the Year

· The Hero Award presented by Coca-Cola

During the day on Monday, December 21, WWE.com will the reveal winners in the following categories:

· WWE Tag Team of the Year

· Hashtag of the Year

· Celebrity Moment of the Year

· "Tell Me You Didn't Just Say That" Moment of the Year

· Best John Cena United States Championship Open Challenge Match of the Year

After Finn Bálor stepped up to World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk last week in a tense war of words, The Second City Saint agreed to give a title match to The Prince, who will enjoy a de facto homefield advantage in Belfast. 

After reclaiming the Women's Intercontinental Championship from Maxxine Dupri, Becky Lynch will defend the title against her bitter rival.

Following his controversial victory over AJ Styles, Gunther kicks off Raw.

Je'Von Evans has defeated Rayo Americano. He has defeated Bravo Americano. Now, officially part of the Raw roster, the dynamic Superstar will go one-on-one with El Grande Americano. 

Rey Mysterio, Penta and Dragon Lee will continue to tangle with The Vision when they take on Logan Paul, Bronson Reed and Austin Theory in a Six-Man Tag Team Match.

A special start time of 3e/12p on Netflix.

episodes.name: #1705 - Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, ON
episodes.summary:
Bron Breakker will meet with Raw General Manager Adam Pearce to discuss his suspension. 

The New Day (Kofi Kingston & Xavier Woods) vs Alpha Academy (Otis & Akira Tozawa) vs Los Americanos (Rayo & Bravo Americano) vs American Made (Brutus Creed & Julius Creed – Fatal four-way to determine the #1 Contenders for the World Tag team titles.

AJ Styles to discuss potential retirement match against Gunther at the Royal Rumble.

One week after shockingly betraying Maxxine Dupri and costing her protégé a chance to win the Women's Intercontinental Title from Becky Lynch, Natalya will address the WWE Universe. 

Gunther interview ahead of Royal Rumble.

episodes.name: #1706 - Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA
episodes.summary:
Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer puts her title on the line against The Judgment Day's Raquel Rodriguez in a Philly Street Fight.

Royal Rumble aftermath.

After outlasting 29 other Superstars and eliminating her Judgment Day ally Raquel Rodriguez, Liv Morgan returns to Raw.

Royal Rumble winner Roman Reigns is set to return to Raw.

After suffering an injury, a couple weeks ago that left his match against El Grande Americano unresolved, Je'Von Evans will once again battle his newfound rival in the aftermath of Royal Rumble. 

Bronson Reed will look to unleash The Vision's fury against the dangerous Penta, tonight on Raw

CM Punk, Rhea Ripley, Jey Uso are listed as featured superstars.

episodes.name: #1707 - Rocket Arena in Cleveland, OH
episodes.summary:
World Tag Team Champions The Usos will defend their title against Otis and Akira Tozawa of Alpha Academy. Who will leave as champions? 

After Nattie betrayed Maxxine Dupri and caused her to lose her Women's Intercontinental Championship Match against Becky Lynch last month, Dupri is out for retribution when they square off tonight. 

Rhea Ripley, Lyra Valkyria and Ivy Nile square off in a Triple Threat Match for the right to step into the deadly Elimination Chamber. 

Penta, LA Knight and Austin Theory collide in a Triple Threat Match for the opportunity to compete in the Elimination Chamber Match on Saturday, Feb. 28.

episodes.name: #1708 - FedExForum in Memphis, TN
episodes.summary:
Je'Von Evans, Gunther and Intercontinental Champion Dominik Mysterio are set to compete in the Men's Elimination Chamber Qualifying Triple Threat Match.

Bayley, Asuka and Nattie are set to battle it out in a Women's Elimination Chamber Triple Threat Qualifying Match. 

World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk takes to the mic tonight as he prepares for two huge title defenses: Finn Bálor at WWE Elimination Chamber and, if he can overcome The Prince of The Judgment Day, Roman Reigns at WrestleMania.

Tonight, Morgan returns to Monday Night Raw and, as always, both Intercontinental Champion Dominik Mysterio and all-out chaos promise to come with her. 

Find out what AJ has to say about her upcoming showdown with Lynch.

episodes.name: #1709 - State Farm Arena in Atlanta, GA
episodes.summary:
World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk will address his matchup with The Prince as well as his scheduled WrestleMania showdown against Roman Reigns. 

Raquel Rodriguez vs Iyo Sky vs Kairi Sane.

Jey Uso, "Original" El Grande Americano and Bronson Reed will collide in a Triple Threat Match for the final spot in the Men's Elimination Chamber. 

WWE celebrates the phenomenal career of one of the greatest Superstars of all time, AJ Styles. 

The Beast is back. Brock Lesnar returns to Monday Night Raw. 

Liv Morgan to decide her WrestleMania fate.

Maxxine Dupri and Nattie the two Superstars once again clash in what is sure to be a destructive rematch. 

Jade Cargill to appear.

episodes.name: #1710 - Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IN
episodes.summary:
Royal Rumble winner Roman Reigns is set to return to Raw for the first time since declaring that he will challenge World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk at WrestleMania.

After his successful title defense against Finn Bálor at WWE Elimination Chamber, World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk is focused on his epic title match against Roman Reigns at WrestleMania. 

Women's Royal Rumble Winner Liv Morgan will take the mic after making the decision to challenge Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer at WrestleMania. 

General Manager Adam Pearce has made it clear that Dominik Mysterio will defend his Intercontinental Championship against Penta, whether Dirty Dom likes it or not. 

After costing Gunther his Elimination Chamber Qualifying Match in the latest chapter of their brutal rivalry last week, Dragon Lee will battle the irate Ring General tonight on Raw.

episodes.name: #1711 - Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, WA
episodes.summary:
IYO SKY, Bayley, Lyra Valkyria, Asuka, Raquel Rodriguez and Ivy Nile will battle in a Gauntlet Match to decide the No. 1 Contender to Women's Intercontinental Champion AJ Lee. 

Following a volatile altercation on last week's Raw, Oba Femi will lock horns with Rusev.

Newly crowned Intercontinental Champion Penta looks to establish himself as a fighting champion when he puts the workhorse title on the line against "Original" El Grande Americano.

episodes.name: #1712 - Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, TX
episodes.summary:
Two weeks after World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk's comments about burying Roman Reigns next to his father, The OTC returns to Raw.

After winning a Gauntlet Match last week on Raw, Bayley will challenge AJ Lee for the Women's Intercontinental Championship, this Monday.

The Beast is back. Brock Lesnar will return to Raw to see who'll answer his WrestleMania challenge.

Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer will once again step into the squared circle with Raquel Rodriguez of The Judgment Day, with her WrestleMania title defense against Liv Morgan looming.

 "Original" El Grande Americano and El Grande Americano will collide in a one-on-one showdown to settle things once and for all. Who will prove himself the true El Grande Americano?

Last week, Maxxine Dupri attacked Nattie as she was badmouthing her adversary. As a result, the two Superstars will square off in a highly personal showdown.

episodes.name: #1713 - TD Garden in Boston, MA
episodes.summary:
World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk and Roman Reigns will be at Monday Night Raw after their latest explosive encounter. How will the Tribal Chief respond to The Best in the World landing the first punch on The Road to WrestleMania?

Last week, Oba Femi answered Brock Lesnar's WrestleMania Open Challenge by hitting The Beast with an earth-shaking Fall from Grace. Find out how Lesnar reacts when he returns to Raw on The Road to WrestleMania.

Jimmy Uso and Jey Uso will put the World Tag Team Title on the line against Theory and Paul. 

Former Women's Intercontinental Champion Becky Lynch will grab a mic and address her blindside attack of current champion AJ Lee.

Bayley and Lyra Valkyria are determined to make it to WrestleMania, and standing in their way are Asuka and Kairi Sane.

The Young OG is back in action on Monday Night Raw when he takes on Grayson Waller.

episodes.name: #1714 - Madison Square Garden in New York, NY
episodes.summary:
World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk and Roman Reigns are both scheduled to be at Raw in Madison Square Garden this Monday.

The World Tag Team Champions will put their title on the line against The Vision in a Street Fight. 

Bayley and Lyra are looking to punch their ticket to WrestleMania. Can they capture the title from The Irresistible Forces?

Penta issued an Intercontinental Championship Open Challenge on social media this weekend, and former WWE Champion Kofi Kingston has answered the call. 

Brock Lesnar is set to return to Monday Night Raw at Madison Square Garden en route to his WrestleMania showdown against Oba Femi. 

Finn Bálor will address the betrayal by his former Judgment Day allies following his shocking return to Raw last Monday.

episodes.name: #1715 - Toyota Center in Houston, TX
episodes.summary:
One week ago, Punk powerbombed The OTC through the announce table. Now, The Second City Saint will address his WrestleMania challenger.

After suffering a brutal attack from Gunther last week, Seth Rollins will kick off Raw tonight to address The Ring General. 

The highly anticipated showdown between Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi on The Grandest Stage of Them All draws near. Brace yourself as both Superstars are set to appear LIVE on Raw.

The Megastar LA Knight will continue to pursue The Vision when he takes on Theory.

As Finn Bálor prepares to battle Dominik Mysterio at WrestleMania, The Prince will go one-on-one with another former Judgment Day brother, a Superstar that he once trained, JD McDonagh. 

Now RHIYO reunite to take on B-Fab and Michin. Which tandem will claim a critical win as The Eradicator prepares to challenge The Storm at WrestleMania?

episodes.name: #1716 - Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, CA
episodes.summary:
Seth Rollins and Gunther will be under one roof en route to their clash on The Grandest Stage of Them All. 

One week after their WrestleMania Contract Signing resulted in an out-of-control brawl, Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi will be LIVE tonight on Raw.

Tonight, The OTC will return with a message for The Second City Saint on the final Raw before their clash at The Showcase of the Immortals.

It is also confirmed that Punk will be on Raw.

episodes.name: #1717 - T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV
episodes.summary:
The OTC announced at the WrestleMania Post-Show that he will be on Raw tonight.  

Liv will be LIVE on the Raw after WrestleMania, tonight.

What's next for The Ruler?  Find out on the Raw after WrestleMania, tonight.

After his epic WrestleMania 42 victory over Dominik Mysterio, Finn Bálor will take on Judgment Day member JD McDonagh. Can Bálor make it two-for-two against his former Judgment Day brethren?

episodes.name: #1718 - Sames Auto Arena in Laredo, TX
episodes.summary:
After giving Fatu a week to think about it, The OTC will make his decision about the challenge. 

The Intercontinental Champion Penta flies back into the ring tonight looking for retribution against Rusev the Bulgarian Brute. 

Returning from a strong showing in the turbulent WWE Women's Tag Team Title Fatal 4-Way Match at WrestleMania, Bayley and Lyra Valkyria are set to take on Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez of The Judgment Day, tonight on Raw.

Becky Lynch will be live tonight on Raw after reclaiming the Women's Intercontinental Championship from AJ Lee on The Grandest Stage of Them All. 

Say his name and he will appear on Monday Night Raw.

episodes.name: #1719 - CHI Health Center in Omaha, NE
episodes.summary:
Reigns and Fatu will make their showdown official in a World Heavyweight Title Contract Signing.

The Era on Oba Femi is upon us and must be forged in battle. The Oba Femi Open Challenge begins tonight. Who will step up to The Ruler?

Intercontinental Champion Penta and Je'Von Evans are set to join forces in an explosive tag team matchup against newly signed Raw Superstar Ethan Page and the menacing Rusev.

NXT free agent Sol Ruca will become the newest member of the Raw roster.

Prior to the highly-anticipated clash at WWE Backlash this Saturday, IYO SKY and Asuka will put it all on the table in a special pre-battle sitdown. The former friends turned bitter enemies come face-to-face, tonight.

Finn Bálor is not done with The Judgment Day. The Prince is set to step into the ring with a man he trained and once rode alongside, the dangerous JD McDonagh.

episodes.name: #1720 - Thompson-Boling Arena in Knoxville, TN
episodes.summary:
Tonight, a special Acknowledgment Ceremony is scheduled to take place. Will Fatu finally acknowledge The Tribal Chief after his defeat? Or will chaos reign?

Who will step up to Oba Femi when The Open Challenge roars on? Find out tonight.

episodes.name: #1721 - Greensboro Coliseum in Greensboro, NC
episodes.summary:
After Jacob Fatu refused to acknowledge The OTC and brutally laid out The Bloodline last week, how will World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns respond? Find out tonight.

The WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella will have retribution on their mind when they put their title on the line against Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez. Who will leave Raw with the gold? Will Women's World Champion Liv Morgan play a part in the outcome?

Who will dare accept tonight's Oba Femi Open Challenge?

With the highly anticipated Mask vs. Mask Match looming at AAA Noche de Los Grandes on Saturday, May 30, "Original" El Grande Americano and Los Americanos Hermanos are set to battle El Grande Americano and Los Americanos in a Trios Tornado Tag Team Match.

episodes.name: #1722 - Schottenstein Center in Columbus, OH
episodes.summary:
Oba Femi opens the show to respond to Brock Lesnar's sneak attack.

World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and Jacob Fatu sign their contract for Tribal Combat.

Penta (c) vs. Je'Von Evans for the Men's Intercontinental Championship.

Bayley and Lyra Valkyria vs. Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez.

Raw General Manager Adam Pearce is expecting Women's Intercontinental Champion Becky Lynch to appear.

episodes.name: #1723 - Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy
episodes.summary:
Intercontinental Champion Penta, Oba Femi, Solo Sikoa and Carmelo Hayes will battle in a Fatal 4-Way King of the Ring First-Round Matchup. Who will earn a crucial win in the high-stakes tournament?

After the brackets were revealed during the WWE Clash in Italy post-show, the King of the Ring Tournament is set to begin today.

After Roman Reigns conquered Jacob Fatu in Tribal Combat to retain the World Heavyweight Title at WWE Clash in Italy, The Samoan Werewolf is now expected to acknowledge The OTC. 

The brackets have been revealed, and the Queen of the Ring Tournament will begin on Raw.

episodes.name: #1723 - Accor Arena in Paris, France
episodes.summary:
Oba Femi will kick off Raw.

Intercontinental Champion Penta is set to defend the workhorse title against Rey Mysterio. 

Seth Rollins, Je'Von Evans, Talla Tonga and Ricky Saints meet in a Fatal 4-Way King of the Ring First-Round Match.

In an epic Fatal 4-Way showdown, Women's World Champion Liv Morgan, Becky Lynch, Alexa Bliss and Chelsea Green will collide to determine who will advance in the Queen of the Ring Tournament. 

Pledging to be a fighting champion, Sol Ruca will defend the Women's Intercontinental Title against inaugural champion Lyra Valkyria.

episodes.name: #1724 - CFG Bank Arena in Baltimore, MD
episodes.summary:
The dominant Ruler will enjoy a size and strength advantage, but Dirty Dom is one of the most cunning Superstars in WWE and won't hesitate to break the rules in search of a win. Plus, The Judgment Day will stop at nothing to make sure that Dominik comes out on top. Don't miss when The Ruler collides with Mysterio in the semifinals of King of the Ring.

Roman Reigns is set to return to Raw tonight, and perhaps not a moment too soon for The Bloodline. How will The Head of the Table respond? 

IYO SKY is set to clash with Raquel Rodriguez in the Queen of the Ring Tournament Semifinals. Can SKY rise above the towering Rodriguez to advance to the final of the Queen of the Ring Tournament? Or is Rodriguez destined to bring the crown back to The Judgment Day? 

Chad Gable will step into the ring with The Bulgarian Brute Rusev in what promises to be an explosive showdown. 

After an exchange on social media, Charlotte Flair will take on Roxanne Perez of The Judgment Day just four days before the 14-time Women's Champion battles Women's World Champion Liv Morgan in the semifinals of the Queen of the Ring Tournament on SmackDown.

episodes.name: #1725 - The O2 in London, England
episodes.summary:
After Angelo Dawkins returned to help Montez Ford save Je'Von Evans from The Vision last week on Raw, The Street Profits are set to challenge World Tag Team Champions Bron Breakker and Austin Theory. 

Last week, Lyra Valkyria revealed to Bayley that she had secured a WWE Women's Tag Team Championship Match against Paige and Brie Bella. Do Bayley and her explosive partner have what it takes to win the title?

episodes.name: #1726 - Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, NJ
episodes.summary:
After scoring an earth-shattering win against Jey Uso in the King of the Ring Final at WWE Night of Champions, 2026 King of the Ring Oba Femi will kick off Monday Night Raw. Will The Ruler reveal whether he will challenge World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns or new Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn at SummerSlam? 

After a backstage verbal altercation with The Judgment Day last week, Chad Gable will go one-on-one with JD McDonagh. 

Last week, Jimmy Uso's match against LA Knight ended with Solo Sikoa hitting a Samoan Spike on Jimmy and The Megastar capitalizing with the BFT to get the win. After the interference, Uso and Knight will again go one-on-one this week. 

Last week, Ethan Page defeated Dragon Lee with a low blow. Now Page will have to contend with Rey Mysterio. Will The Legendary Luchador finally put Page in his place? 

Tonight, Raw will feature a live musical performance by Joe Hendry.

After defeating Women's World Champion Liv Morgan in the Queen of the Ring Final and immediately declaring that she will challenge Liv for the title at SummerSlam, IYO SKY returns to Raw tonight.

episodes.name: #1727 - Allstate Arena in Chicago, IL
episodes.summary:
Last week, Seth Rollins confronted Roman Reigns, who accepted his challenge for a World Heavyweight Championship Match at SummerSlam. One week after the epic confrontation, The Visionary will kick off Raw, tonight. 

Tonight, Sami Zayn defends the championship against Cody Rhodes. 

New World Tag Team Champions Angelo Dawkins and Montez Ford defend the title in a rematch against former champions Bron Breakker & Austin Theory of The Vision.
Will The Street Profits still have the gold after once again tangling with the dangerous faction? Find out tonight.

Women's Intercontinental Champion Sol Ruca is set to put her title on the line against Raquel Rodriguez. 

 The Ruler will discuss his showdown inside the career-altering structure against The Conqueror, tonight.

episodes.name: #1728 - American Airlines Center in Dallas, TX
episodes.summary:
One-time brothers turned bitter rivals Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins are set to take part in a Contract Signing for their World Heavyweight Championship Match at SummerSlam.

As Brock Lesnar's Hell in a Cell Match against Oba Femi draws near, The Beast is returning to Raw tonight. 

Chad Gable, Je'Von Evans, Dragon Lee, Joe Hendry, Dominik Mysterio, Ethan Page and Rusev are set to battle in an Intercontinental Championship No.1 Contender's Gauntlet Match. The winner will face Penta for the Intercontinental Title at SummerSlam. Find out who with challenge Penta at The Biggest Event of the Summer.

2026 Queen of the Ring IYO SKY will go one-on-one with Roxanne Perez of The Judgment Day en route to The Genius of the Sky's SummerSlam showdown with Women's World Champion Liv Morgan.

episodes.name: #1729 - Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, MI
episodes.summary:
Ahead of their Six-Man Tag Team Match at SummerSlam, LA Knight and The Bloodline's Jacob Fatu will collide. 

Will Chad Gable and Penta be able to look past their impending Intercontinental Championship Match to defeat Rusev and Ethan Page?

Je'Von Evans and Dragon Lee will join forces to take on World Tag Team Champions The Visions Austin Theory and Bron Breakker in a non-title bout. 

Oba Femi vs JD McDonagh. 

Joe Hendry vs Dominik Mysterio.

episodes.name: #1730 - Intuit Dome in Los Angeles, CA
episodes.summary:
World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins will come face-to-face for the last time on Raw before their highly-anticipated title fight at SummerSlam. 

The World Tag Team Championship may not be on the line, but plenty of pride will be when Alpha Academy Otis and Akira Tozawa go head-to-head with Bron Breakker and Austin Theory.

Raw General Manager Adam Pearce has ordered a weigh-in between Oba Femi and Brock Lesnar, an event that will be moderated by Paul "Triple H" Levesque en route to the Hell in a Cell Match pitting The Ruler against The Beast at The Biggest Event of the Summer. Will the two fierce Superstars make it to SummerSlam?

Joe Hendry is looking to treat the WWE Universe to a concert with special guest Danhausen. 

After the mighty Rusev eliminated him during an Intercontinental Championship No. 1 Contender's Gauntlet Match on Raw two weeks ago, Je'Von Evans is looking to get bouncy against The Bulgarian Brute Rusev. 

 Sol Ruca will be ready for a slugfest when she puts her Women's Intercontinental Champion on the line against Raquel Rodriguez.

episodes.summary: USA Network, the exclusive cable home to WWE's marquee properties, is providing expanded access to 2017's WRESTLEMANIA, WWE's biggest event of the year. On Sunday, April 2 at 6/5c, USA will feature a live, one-hour broadcast of the second hour of the official WRESTLEMANIA KICKOFF SHOW. The WRESTLEMANIA KICKOFF SHOW will include predictions and commentary for the night's action by hosts Renee Young and WWE Hall of Famers Booker T, Jerry "The King" Lawler and Shawn Michaels.
